property_summary: Filling a LONG order must record the expiration only under the maker's long position id (uint256(hashOrder(order))), leaving the taker's position id (uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order))) unexpired (zero); the mutant always writes the expiration under the taker's positionId, so for long orders the taker's position carries a nonzero expiration.
change_summary: Always record the expiration under the taker's positionId instead of branching on order.isLong.
